description: RawDB backend metrics: HTTP traffic, latency, per-user breakdown, and S3 scanner health.

panels.description: Apdex score (satisfied T=0.5s, tolerating up to 2s). Frustrated requests include all 5xx responses regardless of latency, so they sit in the denominator but contribute 0 to the numerator. Total uses the `+Inf` bucket — robust against any `_count`/`_count_total` naming variation in the OTel→Prometheus exporter.
panels.title: Apdex (T=0.5s)

panels.description: Number of RawDB pods reporting `rawdb_service_up`.
panels.title: Services up

panels.description: Total HTTP requests served across all pods within the selected time range.
panels.title: Total requests

panels.description: Approximate bytes handed out by sample downloads across all pods within the selected time range (`rawdb_http_samples_download_bytes_total`). Presigned downloads count the full file size at redirect time.
panels.title: Total downloaded

panels.description: All increments of `rawdb_core_internal_errors_total` in the selected time range (HTTP + scanner combined).
panels.title: Total internal errors

panels.description: Scanner `run_once` failures (one per failed full-scan cycle) in the selected time range.
panels.title: Failed scans

panels.description: Supported camera models: distinct (maker, model) sets that aren't special. Every pod reports the totals of the whole catalog from its own cache, so pods are combined with `max`, not `sum`.
panels.title: Camera models

panels.description: Approved sets marked special (non-camera samples). Every pod reports the totals of the whole catalog from its own cache, so pods are combined with `max`, not `sum`.
panels.title: Non-camera sets

panels.description: Files across all approved sets. Every pod reports the totals of the whole catalog from its own cache, so pods are combined with `max`, not `sum`.
panels.title: Sample files

panels.description: Uploads waiting for review. Every pod reports the totals of the whole catalog from its own cache, so pods are combined with `max`, not `sum`.
panels.title: Pending uploads

panels.description: Apdex over time (same formula as the Overview stat). Dips here precede client complaints; cross-reference with the status-codes panel below to tell latency drift from a 5xx surge.
panels.title: Apdex over time (T=0.5s)

panels.description: Per-pod request rate plus a thicker `total` line across pods.
panels.title: Requests/s by pod

panels.description: Per-status request rate across all pods.
panels.title: HTTP status codes

panels.description: Heatmap of `rawdb_core_http_requests_duration_bucket` rate by bucket boundary `le`.
panels.title: HTTP request duration

panels.description: Request count grouped by the `username` label (resolved from a valid X-API-Key; anonymous traffic surfaces as `public`).
panels.title: Requests per user (range total)

panels.description: Approximate bytes handed out by sample downloads (`rawdb_http_samples_download_bytes_total`), grouped by `username` as in Requests per user (API-key owner, else `public`). Presigned downloads count the full file size at redirect time.
panels.title: Downloaded bytes per user (range total)

panels.description: Per-user request rate over time. Pair with the pie chart on the left to see whether share-of-traffic shifts over the window or stays steady.
panels.title: Requests/s per user

panels.description: Mean scan wall time over the scrape interval (sum / count of `rawdb_scan_duration_seconds`).
panels.title: Scan duration (mean)

panels.description: Heatmap of `rawdb_scan_duration_seconds_bucket` rate by bucket boundary `le`.
panels.title: Scan duration heatmap

panels.description: Share of hits among response-cache lookups in the selected time range, across all pods. `rawdb_response_cache_lookups_total` (rendered feeds, stats and catalog lists; hit = served from memory, miss = rebuilt).
panels.title: Response cache hit ratio

panels.description: Share of hits among inspection lookups in the selected time range, across all pods. `rawdb_inspect_lookups_total` (previews and exiftool listings; hit = served from the disk cache, miss = waited for a download job, error = internal failure).
panels.title: Inspection cache hit ratio

panels.description: Files downloaded from S3 for inspection in the selected time range, across all pods. One download feeds every processor (`rawdb_inspect_duration_seconds_count{processor="download"}`).
panels.title: Inspection downloads

panels.description: Inspection requests that failed internally (S3 or local I/O) in the selected time range, across all pods (`rawdb_inspect_lookups_total{result="error"}`). Files without a preview or listing are not errors.
panels.title: Inspection errors

panels.description: Lookup rate by cache and result. `rawdb_response_cache_lookups_total` (rendered feeds, stats and catalog lists; hit = served from memory, miss = rebuilt).
panels.title: Response cache lookups/s

panels.description: Lookup rate by processor and result. `rawdb_inspect_lookups_total` (previews and exiftool listings; hit = served from the disk cache, miss = waited for a download job, error = internal failure).
panels.title: Inspection lookups/s

panels.description: Processor runs and shared downloads per second (`rawdb_inspect_duration_seconds_count`, `processor="download"` for downloads).
panels.title: Inspection runs/s

panels.description: Mean time per processor run and per download (sum / count of `rawdb_inspect_duration_seconds`).
panels.title: Inspection time (mean)

title: RawDB
